experiments:
- id: plan_001_h1_cpu_mvp
  claim: C_H1_GLOBAL_CORRECTION_WORSE
  description: >
    CPU-only semi-synthetic MVP for H1. Compare uncorrected, oracle global
    confusion correction, estimated global confusion correction, and
    stratified/subgroup correction on the positive-correlation worst-case DGP.
    This isolates structural global-correction bias from finite-sample confusion
    estimation noise.
  registry_id: exp_001_bias_bound_mvp
  role: primary
  priority: P0
  gpu_budget_hours: 0
  deps: []
  matrix_targets:
  - target_id: C_H1_GLOBAL_CORRECTION_WORSE
    cells:
    - row: exp_001_bias_bound_mvp
      col: uncorrected_vs_oracle_global
    - row: exp_001_bias_bound_mvp
      col: uncorrected_vs_estimated_global
  - target_id: T_STAGE0_DGP_GRID
    cells:
    - row: positive_corr_high_mis_high_cate
      col: uncorrected_gate_rmse
    - row: positive_corr_high_mis_high_cate
      col: oracle_global_gate_rmse
    - row: positive_corr_high_mis_high_cate
      col: estimated_global_gate_rmse
    - row: positive_corr_high_mis_high_cate
      col: stratified_gate_rmse
  operational_criteria:
    primary_metric: gate_rmse
    secondary_metrics:
    - mean_subgroup_cate_bias
    - max_subgroup_cate_bias
    minimum_replications: 200
    success_rule: >
      In the positive-correlation high-misclassification/high-CATE-heterogeneity
      setting, oracle_global - uncorrected must be greater than 0 on the primary
      metric gate_rmse, with a bootstrap 95% CI lower bound above 0. Estimated global
      is reported separately; estimated_global - oracle_global quantifies
      finite-sample confusion-estimation noise.
    diagnostic_rule: >
      mean_subgroup_cate_bias and max_subgroup_cate_bias must be reported for all
      methods as secondary diagnostics. If gate_rmse supports H1 but either bias
      diagnostic points in the opposite direction, the result is marked mixed and
      requires Director review before Stage 1.
    negative_rule: >
      If oracle_global is not worse than uncorrected under the positive-correlation
      worst-case setting, H1 is not supported and the next step is to audit DGP
      construction, correction algebra, metric definitions, and subgroup weighting
      before running Stage 1.

- id: plan_002_h1_gpu_dgp_grid
  claim: C_H1_GLOBAL_CORRECTION_WORSE
  description: >
    GPU-vectorized DGP grid for H1. Systematically vary misclassification
    heterogeneity, CATE heterogeneity, subgroup count, and correlation direction;
    compare oracle global and estimated global correction against uncorrected and
    stratified/subgroup correction.
  registry_id: exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid
  role: primary
  priority: P0
  gpu_budget_hours: 2
  deps:
  - plan_001_h1_cpu_mvp
  matrix_targets:
  - target_id: C_H1_GLOBAL_CORRECTION_WORSE
    cells:
    - row: exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid
      col: grid_oracle_vs_estimated_mechanism_split
  - target_id: T_STAGE0_DGP_GRID
    cells:
    - row: grid_all_conditions
      col: bias_bound_auc_or_rank_corr
    - row: grid_all_conditions
      col: oracle_estimated_gap
  operational_criteria:
    primary_metric: global_worse_rate_difference_positive_minus_negative
    secondary_metrics:
    - bias_bound_vs_global_worse_spearman
    - estimated_global_minus_oracle_global_gate_rmse
    minimum_replications_per_condition: 200
    success_rule: >
      Positive-correlation conditions must have at least a 20 percentage-point
      higher oracle-global-worse rate than negative-correlation controls, with a
      bootstrap 95% CI lower bound above 0. The bias-bound diagnostic must rank
      oracle-global-worse conditions with Spearman rho >= 0.50 and bootstrap 95%
      CI lower bound above 0. Estimated-global results must be reported separately
      from oracle global to avoid conflating structural bias with
      confusion-estimation noise.
    launch_gate: >
      This experiment may only run after Director approval and GPU allocation.
      Before allocation it may only prepare code, configs, dry-runs, and proposal
      artifacts.

- id: plan_003_stage1_correction_ablation
  claim: C_PARTIAL_POOLING_BETTER_LOW_BUDGET
  description: >
    Stage 1 correction ablation comparing global, arm-specific, per-subgroup
    independent, and hierarchical/partial-pooling correction under matched expert
    label budgets.
  role: follow_up
  priority: P1
  gpu_budget_hours: 4
  registry_id: exp_003_stage1_correction_ablation
  deps:
  - plan_001_h1_cpu_mvp
  - plan_002_h1_gpu_dgp_grid
  matrix_targets:
  - target_id: C_PARTIAL_POOLING_BETTER_LOW_BUDGET
    cells:
    - row: low_budget
      col: partial_pooling_vs_global
    - row: low_budget
      col: partial_pooling_vs_per_subgroup
  - target_id: T_STAGE1_CORRECTION_ABLATION
    cells:
    - row: budget_low
      col: global
    - row: budget_low
      col: arm_specific
    - row: budget_low
      col: per_subgroup_independent
    - row: budget_low
      col: partial_pooling
    - row: budget_mid
      col: global
    - row: budget_mid
      col: arm_specific
    - row: budget_mid
      col: per_subgroup_independent
    - row: budget_mid
      col: partial_pooling
  operational_criteria:
    primary_metric: gate_rmse
